0 · Harness at a glance / 流程图总览

1 · What KernelFactory is, and how its harness works

KernelFactory (kf CLI, kernelfactory.nvidia.com) is NVIDIA's multi-agent GPU-kernel optimization platform. You define a problem in the CudaGym/SOLBench schema; the platform then runs a campaign: sequential rounds, each spawning a pool of LLM coding agents in parallel (here: 2× Claude Fable-5 @max + 2× Codex GPT-5.6-sol @xhigh + 2× N3 Claude-Opus-4.8) that write CUDA kernels, evaluate them on real GPUs, see each other's results and insights from earlier rounds, and evolve solutions via mutation / crossover / random strategies until the round budget, a convergence target, or a stagnation limit ends the campaign.

1.1 The evaluation harness (CudaGym / SOLBench)

ComponentRole in the harness
definition.jsonThe problem contract: named axes (const / var / derived-expr), inputs/outputs as ordered tensor specs (shape strings refer to axes; scalars use shape:null), a pure-PyTorch reference implementation (def run(...)) used as ground truth, and an optional custom_correctness_entrypoint replacing the default elementwise-tolerance check.
workload.jsonlOne test case per line: concrete axis values + input sources (random / scalar / safetensors blob / custom generator). Per-workload custom_correctness_kwargs are passed as kwargs into the custom checker.
baselines.jsonlPer-workload target timings ({"uuid", "execution_time_ms"}). Candidate speedup = baseline_time / candidate_time per workload; the campaign's fitness aggregates speedup + correctness (+ efficiency, novelty) with 40/30/20/10 default weights.
SolutionAn agent submission: source files + build spec. CUDA C++ solutions are built with tvm_ffi.cpp.build into benchmark_kernel.so (TVM-FFI TensorView ABI, inputs first then outputs, no torch/extension.h). The eval driver loads it, generates/loads inputs, runs correctness then a warm-up + timed benchmark loop (CUDA-event based) per workload, and records a Trace (status, latency, speedup, logs).
Compliance judgeAn LLM judge inspects every submission: CUDA-graph capture/replay banned (would measure launch amortization, not kernel work) and framework-kernel imports banned (flashinfer / trtllm / tensorrt_llm at any level) — kernels must be original computation.
Agent-side toolsInside the agent pod: compile server, GPU eval server, ncu/nsys/compute-sanitizer profiling, a shared DB of all candidates + inter-agent insights messaging.

1.2 Campaign lifecycle used here

kf campaign init gvr-topk-bs1-real --definition definition.json --workloads workload.jsonl \
  --baselines baselines.jsonl --prompt-file prompt.md --gpu-spec b200 --language cuda_cpp \
  --effort max --max-rounds 20 --max-duration 28800 --stagnation-limit 4 --asset cell_*.safetensors ×28
kf campaign prepare --from ws/campaign.yaml   # validates definition/workloads + stamps baselines
kf campaign start   --from ws/campaign.yaml   # → id tfb91bvwm972kfyf1bc1trj5e0

2 · Problem encoding (what the agents optimize)

Op: top-K index selection over one real captured indexer-logits row (BS=1, fp32): inputs logits[1, npad] (npad = ceil(n/64)·64, tail padded with fp32-min), pre_idx[1, k] (previous decode step's top-K = temporal warm hint), scalar n_valid; output indices[1, k] int32, any order.

Correctness: tie-robust set semantics via custom_correctness_entrypoint=check_topk: per workload we precomputed mandatory (values > k-th value — must all be present) and tie (values == k-th value — any subset may fill the rest); checker also enforces uniqueness and range. This mirrors the PR#16457 equivalence-test semantics (index-set, tie-either-way).

Workloads: 28 stratified real cells from the 865-cell §4 grid — 3 models (Flash K=512 / Pro K=1024 / V3.2 K=2048) × ISL rungs (4k→1M) × {min-hit, max-hit} layer per rung. Hit range 0.023–1.0; N range 1027–262127; assets 9.8 MB safetensors.

Baseline: per-cell PR#16457 GVR timings from real_3arm_layers_full.csv (pr column; nsys pure-kernel cold-L2 on umbriel-b200-027), 5–29 µs, geomean 14.40 µs. Methodology caveat: campaign eval times warm-loop CUDA events on the managed pool, so campaign-reported speedups are steering signals, not the verdict — the acceptance gate is a local 865-cell nsys cold-L2 paired A/B on our own B200s.

Prompt steering: prompt.md distills the GVR falsification history (12+ dead ends: fused count+collect, smem staging, secant multi-round, CUB sort, single-CTA occupancy wall) and points at the two live structural levers: multi-CTA-per-row cooperation (sglang-style ≈1.4× existence proof) and histogram/radix select over fp32-ordered-uint keys; requires geomean ≥1.30× with no cell below ~1.05× (margin over the +20% final bar).

3 · Decisions & deviations

DecisionRationale
Baseline from REPORT CSV, not re-measured on the campaign harness User directive. Cold-L2 nsys baselines vs warm campaign eval inflates apparent speedups ⇒ prompt demands 1.30× margin; final gate is local.
Managed b200 pool, not BYOG on umbriel-b200-027 BYOG needs a local CudaGym server (source at gitlab-master atlas/cudagym) — no gitlab credentials available on this box. Local 8×B200 are instead the continuous validation arm: every round's best kernel is re-measured locally on the full grid.
28-cell campaign subset of the 865-cell grid Per-candidate eval cost: every candidate runs all workloads; 865 would blow the 600 s eval budget. Stratified subset + full-grid local verdict.
CUDA C++ language (not CuTe DSL) Strongest search space for this latency-bound scalar-select op; the known 1.4× rival (sglang v2) is plain CUDA; integration into TRT-LLM as a custom op is acceptable for PR#2.

1 · KernelFactory 是什么,harness 原理

KernelFactory(kf CLI)是 NVIDIA 的多 agent GPU kernel 优化平台。 用 CudaGym/SOLBench 格式定义问题,平台跑战役(campaign):顺序执行多个 轮次,每轮并行拉起一池 LLM 编码 agent(本战役:2× Claude Fable-5 @max + 2× Codex GPT-5.6-sol @xhigh + 2× N3 Claude-Opus-4.8),它们编写 CUDA kernel、在真 GPU 上评测、 共享历史轮次的候选与洞察,以变异/杂交/随机策略演化解,直到轮次预算、收敛目标或 停滞上限终止。

1.1 评测 harness(CudaGym / SOLBench)

组件在 harness 中的角色
definition.json问题契约:axes(常量/变量/表达式派生)、 按序的 inputs/outputs 张量规格(shape 引用 axis 名;标量用 shape:null)、 作为真值的纯 PyTorch reference 实现,以及可选的 custom_correctness_entrypoint(替换默认的逐元素容差检查)。
workload.jsonl每行一个测试用例:具体 axis 取值 + 输入来源 (random/scalar/safetensors blob/custom 生成器)。 每 workload 的 custom_correctness_kwargs 以 kwargs 传入自定义检查器。
baselines.jsonl逐 workload 目标时延。候选 加速比 = 基线时间 / 候选时间;fitness 按 40/30/20/10 聚合(性能/正确性/效率/新颖性)。
Solutionagent 提交:源码 + 构建规格。CUDA C++ 用 tvm_ffi.cpp.build 编译为 benchmark_kernel.so(TVM-FFI TensorView ABI)。 评测驱动加载后:先正确性、再 warm-up + CUDA-event 计时循环,逐 workload 记录 Trace。
合规裁判LLM 裁判审查每个提交:默认禁 CUDA graph(那是测发射摊销, 不是 kernel 本身)且禁框架 kernel 导入(flashinfer/trtllm 等任何层级)——必须原创计算。
agent 侧工具agent pod 内:编译服务、GPU 评测服务、 ncu/nsys/compute-sanitizer、全候选共享 DB + agent 间 insight 消息。

2 · 问题编码(agent 优化的目标)

算子:单行真实 indexer logits 的 top-K 索引选择(BS=1 fp32): logits[1,npad](尾部 fp32-min 填充)、pre_idx[1,k](上一 decode 步 top-K = 时间warm提示)、标量 n_valid;输出 indices[1,k] int32 任意序。

正确性:tie-鲁棒集合语义:每 workload 预计算 mandatory(严格大于第 K 值, 必须全含)与 tie(等于第 K 值,任意子集补足),另查唯一性与范围 —— 与 PR#16457 等价性测试同语义。

Workload:865-cell §4 网格的 28 个分层抽样 cell(3 模型 × ISL 梯 × 最低/最高命中层), hit 0.023–1.0,N 1027–262127,资产 9.8 MB。

基线:real_3arm_layers_full.csv 的 pr 列(nsys 纯 kernel 冷 L2,本机实测),5–29µs。口径注意:campaign 评测是 warm 循环 CUDA-event,其加速比 只是导向信号;判决门 = 本地 865-cell nsys 冷-L2 配对 A/B。

Prompt 导向:注入 GVR 证伪史(12+ 死路)与两条活杠杆(多 CTA 协作 = sglang ~1.4× 存在性证明;fp32-ordered-uint 直方图/radix 选择),要求几何均值 ≥1.30× 且无 cell 低于 ~1.05×。

3 · 关键决策

决策理由
基线直接取 REPORT CSV(用户指示)冷 L2 基线 vs warm 评测会虚增加速比 ⇒ prompt 抬高目标至 1.30× 留余量;终审在本地。
托管 b200 池而非本机 BYOGBYOG 需本机装 CudaGym server(源在 gitlab-master, 本机无凭据)。本机 8×B200 改作持续验证臂:每轮最优 kernel 本地全网格复测。
28-cell 子集每个候选都要跑全部 workload,865 个会爆 600s 评测预算; 分层抽样 + 本地全网格终审。
CUDA C++(非 CuTe DSL)latency-bound 标量选择算子的最大搜索空间; 已知 1.4× 对手(sglang v2)就是纯 CUDA。

7.2 Where the new speed comes from / 新增速度来源

  1. Cooperative-launch & barrier-ordering elimination / 去 coop-launch 与屏障内存序 (09d13c81, +4.7% grid): regular launch + sense-token spin barrier (host generation counter ⇒ tokens never collide across launches, no per-launch reset), grid sized to co-residency. Every formally-ordered variant measured 8–11% slower — the win IS the omitted ordering. Safety argument (R3_LEDGER.md): merged-histogram lines are first plain-touched only after the barrier; L1 invalidates at launch boundaries; pre-barrier writes are L2 atomics ⇒ post-barrier plain loads cannot observe stale L1. Flagged for production-port review.
    常规 launch + sense 令牌自旋屏障(host 代数计数器,跨 launch 永不撞号); 一切形式化排序变体都慢 8-11% — 胜利正是来自省掉排序。安全论证:merged histogram 在屏障前无 plain 读、L1 在 kernel 边界失效、 屏障前写为 L2 原子 ⇒ 屏障后 plain 读不可能命中陈旧 L1。已标记为生产移植评审项。
    barrier variant / 屏障变体memory ordering / 内存序28-cell cold gm vs PRverdict / 判决
    09d13c81 as-harvestedrelaxed intrinsics, no fence~1.72fastest — the win source / 胜利来源
    + __threadfence pairmembar.gl1.566−11%, rejected / 否决
    scoped acq_rel asmatom.acq_rel / ld.acquire.gpu1.614−8%, rejected / 否决
    surgical (relaxed spin + trailing acquire)scoped, off-critical-path attempt1.615rejected — ordering cost is intrinsic / 否决:排序代价是本质的(release 必须在关键路径上等 L2 写落地)
  2. Contiguous-slice scan / 连续切片扫描 (30e79029, +1.2%): per-block contiguous float4 slices replace grid-stride interleave — better cold-data locality. 每块扫连续 float4 切片,替代 grid-stride 交错,冷数据局部性更好。
  3. Adaptive post-pass-0 finish + register-cached row / 自适应收尾 + 寄存器缓存整行 (becdc5c7, +1.5% net): one 11-bit MSB histogram pass, then 3-way dispatch on boundary-bucket size T — whole-bucket direct write (1 barrier); T≤4096: smem-staged compaction + non-spinning rendezvous + last-arriver single-block 21-bit refine (1 barrier, no drain); else classic 11/11/10 ladder. Keys live in registers (1×float4 + tail scalar per thread) — zero global re-reads across passes. Slow twins (large-tie cells) gain 1.37–1.51×; v32 mid-n prefers the 30e7 ladder → engineer dispatch = compB.
    一遍 11-bit MSB histogram 后按边界桶大小三路分派:整桶直写(1 屏障)/小桶 smem 压缩 + 非自旋会合 + 末位到达块独占精化(1 屏障,无排水尾)/大桶回退 11/11/10 梯子;keys 全程驻寄存器,后续 pass 零全局重读。 慢双子格收益 1.37-1.51×;v32 中档偏好 30e7 梯子 → 工程师分派 = compB。

7.4 Skeleton-constraint adjudication / 骨架约束裁决

Decision (operator, 2026-07-22): Bar-first, loose-skeleton per the campaign-1 precedent. The composite lineage keeps (b) threshold refinement — in histogram-prefix form — and (c) the exact tie-robust refine, but does NOT consume pre_idx: constraint (a) is vacated by measurement, not neglect. Hint-seeded variants were falsified repeatedly (June history ×12; campaign-1 round-1 ×3; R3 5f3daaf8: a provably-exact warm filter — admission superset ≥k regardless of hint quality — measured WASH 1.0001 inside its own n≥512K activation zone). The +60% bar and a strict GVR skeleton are mutually incompatible on this workload (in-skeleton ceiling ≈1.28, op20/21/35). No cosmetic hint path is added.
裁决(2026-07-22,用户):Bar 优先,骨架按第一期先例宽松解读。(a) preIdx 先验由测量证据豁免 (hint 变体屡次证伪;R3 的可证明精确 warm-filter 在其自身激活区亦为 1.0001 WASH);(b) 以 histogram 前缀精化等价保留; (c) 完整保留。+60% 门与严格 GVR 骨架在本负载上互斥(骨架内天花板 ≈1.28)。不做化妆式 hint 挂载。

7.5 Incidents & discipline / 事故与纪律

  • Foreign 8-GPU job intermittently occupies this node since day-1 ~17:40Z: one probe verdict invalidated (unconditional quiet-echo scripting bug → fixed to gated launches); one aef33fac full grid discarded (anchor p95 1.542). All measurements now anchor-gated per cell; grids run on explicitly-free GPU lists (drive_grid_gpulist.sh).
    外部 8 卡作业间歇占用本节点:一次探针判废(quiet-echo 无条件 bug,已改门控);一次 aef33fac 全格判废 (锚 p95 1.542)。此后逐格锚检 + 空闲卡白名单分片。
  • Platform noise calibrated in round 1: a verbatim champion resubmission scored 0.9956 (±0.5% band); an agent logged the same solution timing 17/23/20 vs 23/28/26 µs across runs.
    平台噪声标定:champion 原样重交 = 0.9956; agent 自证同一 solution 两次计时差异显著。
  • Platform gap (D1): prepare --baseline-solution does not stage campaign assets (0/28 safetensors found) → champion baselines supplied as platform-trace per-workload timings; champion source inlined in the prompt instead.
    平台缺口 D1:baseline-solution 评测不带 assets → 改用第一期平台 trace 逐格时间,源码内联 prompt。
